Specification: This module specifies the level-checking for the TLA+ language. It defines semantic-node structures, level metadata, and recursive correctness conditions used to determine when expressions are level-correct.
IfThenElse: IF i > j THEN i ELSE j
IF S = {} THEN 0 ELSE CHOOSE x \in S : \A y \in S : x \geq y
IF i \in DOMAIN s THEN s[i] ELSE t[i]
IF \E lc \in LC : lc.param = id THEN LET minLC == CHOOSE lc \in LC : /\ lc.param = id /\ \A olc \in LC : (olc.param = id) => (olc.level \geq lc.level) IN minLC.level ELSE 3
IF \E lc \in ALC : isALC(lc) THEN LET max == CHOOSE lc \in ALC : /\ isALC(lc) /\ \A olc \in ALC : isALC(olc) => (olc.level \leq lc.level) IN max.level ELSE 0
IF \E i \in paramNums : subst.subFor[i] = id THEN LET subExpNum == CHOOSE i \in paramNums : subst.subFor[i] = id IN Node[subst.subWith[subExpNum]].levelParams ELSE {id}
IF \E i \in paramNums : subst.subFor[i] = opid THEN LET subExpNum == CHOOSE i \in paramNums : subst.subFor[i] = opid IN Node[subst.subWith[subExpNum]].ref ELSE opid

IF \E i \in 1..Len(subst.subFor) : subst.subFor[i] = alc.param THEN LET subExpNum == CHOOSE i \in argNums : subst.subFor[i] = alc.param IN IF Node[subst.subWith[subExpNum]].ref \in OpDeclNodeId THEN {[alc EXCEPT !.param = Node[subst.subWith[subExpNum]].ref]} ELSE {} ELSE {alc}
IF SubOp(alp.op) \in OpDeclNodeId THEN {[param |-> SubOp(alp.op), idx   |-> alp.idx, level |-> Node[subst.subWith[i]].level]} ELSE {}
IF SubOp(alp.op) \in OpDeclNodeId THEN {[alp EXCEPT !.op = SubOp(alp.op), !.param = pId] : pId \in ParamSubst(alp.param)} ELSE {}
IF mparamId[i] \in subExp.levelParams THEN mexp[i].level ELSE 0
IF n.operator \in OpDeclNodeId THEN DeclaredOpApplNodeLevelCorrect(n) ELSE DefinedOpApplNodeLevelCorrect(n)

IF n.ref \in OpDeclNodeId \cup BoundSymbolNodeId THEN /\ n.levelParams         = IF n.ref \in ConstantDeclNodeId THEN {n.ref} ELSE { } /\ n.levelConstraints    = { } /\ n.argLevelConstraints = { } /\ n.argLevelParams      = { } ELSE /\ n.levelParams         = Node[n.ref].levelParams /\ n.levelConstraints    = Node[n.ref].levelConstraints /\ n.argLevelConstraints = Node[n.ref].argLevelConstraints /\ n.argLevelParams      = Node[n.ref].argLevelParams
